title:
Meal prep for
the whole week
in [[90 minutes]]
subtitle: 7 STEPS · SUNDAY ONLY · 5 DAYS OF FOOD
label: MEAL PREP SYSTEM

steps.label: PLAN
steps.title: Plan 3 meals
steps.line: Pick three recipes that share at least five ingredients, so one shop covers the whole week.

steps.label: SHOP
steps.title: One shop
steps.line: One list sorted by aisle. It takes 25 minutes instead of three trips during the week.

steps.label: BATCH
steps.title: Batch cook
steps.line: Oven, stove and rice cooker at the same time: three things cooking, one hour.

steps.label: PORTION
steps.title: Portion it
steps.line: Fifteen boxes, each labelled with the day, so nobody has to decide anything on a Tuesday.

steps.label: COST
steps.title: The real cost
steps.line: Homemade boxes against takeaway for the same five days.

steps.label: FREEZE
steps.title: Freeze half
steps.line: Wednesday to Friday go in the freezer, so the food on Friday tastes like Monday.

steps.label: REPEAT
steps.title: Repeat it
steps.line: Rotate four menus. After a month you never plan from zero again.

4.title: Comment [[PREP]] for my 4 menus
4.line: The four rotating menus with every shopping list.
